summary: PhysicsLabValidationContract still accepts integer-valued schema identity and resource-count fields beyond IEEE-754's exact integer range, allowing distinct JSON evidence integers to alias after decode; expected-red PR #346 pins the fail-closed boundary.
evidence: PR #303 head e09c617bac644a5a6a124ae8e22320d39fd59296 uses isFinite(value) plus integer/modulo/order checks but no <= 9007199254740991 exactness ceiling in isNonNegativeInteger/isPositiveInteger.
labSchemaVersion and resolvedRegionSchemaVersion use isPositiveInteger; every resource count uses isNonNegativeInteger.
Docs/PHYSICS_LAB_VALIDATION.md defines these snapshots as JSON evidence identity and requires before/after comparisons to reject different lab/resolved schema truth.

Expected-red draft PR #346 exact head ab3c63a2a6a37c1bfe07da1bf23000864cb86558 changes only tests/physics_lab_validation_contract.luau and requires rejection of MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1 for both schema-version fields and counts.instances.
PR #303 is also two commits behind current main ae83c0ef470eb2e73d99be41fd3561ede30c40e1 and must synchronize after consuming the repair.
